messages:
maria: FYI nightly e2e longseq gate turned red on p99. Dropped from ~120ms to ~420ms after last merge. Job: https://ci.internal/jenkins/job/e2e-longseq/4567 :eyes:
ci-bot: FAILED: e2e-longseq/nightly (job 4567) — p99 = 420ms, threshold 200ms. Tests: longseq-500/1024/2048. Logs: https://ci.internal/logs/4567
ash: (typo) sorry, meant ashok^^
ash not participant: ignore
ash message removed
ash: 
ash: (this line intentionally short)
maria: @ashok can you triage?
ashok: on it. grabbing the diffs now. earliest red at commit 17236fff per pipeline history. last green was 17234abcd.
jamie: I can help run local repros. any suspected PR?
zane: PR #4823 touched KV cache flush and some batching heuristics. saw a tiny perf blip in a perf run earlier but not this big.
maria: ok can we bisect narrow range 17234abcd..17236fff and rerun longseq with 3 repeats? @ci-bot trigger `e2e-longseq-bisect` with that range please.
ci-bot: Command received: `bisect e2e-longseq --range=17234abcd..17236fff --repeats=3` — queued as job 4570. ETA ~12m.
sre-oncall: quick question — any infra deploys in the same window?
zane: none. only runtime change in model-serving repo (PR #4823).
ajmie: (typo) jamie here — repro steps I'm going to try locally:
```
# reproduce longseq p99
git checkout 17235cde
KVCACHE_ENABLE=1 make e2e-longseq TARGET=2048 REPEAT=5 | tee /tmp/longseq.log
# grep p99 line
grep p99 /tmp/longseq.log
```
jamie: will paste logs in a bit.
ci-bot: Bisect job 4570 finished. Suspect commit: 17235cde (PR #4823). P99 delta +290ms vs baseline. Full bisect log: https://ci.internal/logs/4570
ash: (this is still "ash" in channel, ignore)
maria: thanks CI. @ashok can you stage a revert PR if bisect confirmed?
ashok: creating revert PR now, will reference 17235cde. PR 4839 created: https://git.internal/r/4839 — requesting quick review from @zane and @jamie.
jamie: I pulled commit 17235cde and reproduced locally. p99 jumps from 115ms -> 405ms with default batcher. log snippet:
```
[run] seq=2048 p95=180ms p99=405ms
[run] seq=1024 p95=120ms p99=210ms
[run] seq=512 p95=110ms p99=115ms
```
zane: confirmed. KV cache flush path adds a sync in the generation loop under high token counts. Fix idea: make flush async and gated by batch size. Will open a small patch after revert.
maria: plan: merge revert PR 4839 to get nightly back to green, then land fix. @sre-oncall please monitor next nightly.
sre-oncall: will watch. setting alert to slack and infra dashboard.
maria: thanks everyone. follow-ups: jamie — attach repro artifacts to the revert PR; zane — link patch plan in PR comment; ashok — queue revert patch review.
jamie: on it, uploading logs to PR. :thumbsup:
ashok: revert merged (4839) — rolling nightly rerun now (job 4580).
ci-bot: job 4580 started.
ci-bot: job 4580 finished. e2e-longseq/nightly — PASS. p99=118ms. Nightly green again.
maria: closing the loop, great work. I'll create a short postmortem note with root cause and follow-up actions.
